topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 33 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (systemepoch, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
